en: The Aspiration for Generating the Bodhicitta of the Noble Mañjuśrī,
transmitted by Ba Kan Lo-mu-wa from the Mountain of Gan-chun Ma-ti, translated by the Master Shen of Shou-fen.
Translated by the niece Zhìhuì, I pay homage to all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.
You who protect and deliver all those dwelling before you, who have ultimately resolved to generate the bodhicitta,
and who bring benefit to all sentient beings, leading transmigrating beings to the further shore.
The deluded mind and the angry mind are my original nature; Avarice, greed, and arrogance are my original nature.
From this day until I reach enlightenment, Until that realization is attained, I shall no longer commit evil deeds.
I shall abandon both greed and anger, And by restraining myself and training according to the teachings, may I always remain joyful.
Rejoicing in the realization of the Perfectly Awakened One regarding the sphere of practice,
and never abandoning the path of awakening through the roots of virtue one has constantly cultivated oneself; as long as even a single sentient being has not been liberated,
one shall remain and continuously transform and benefit them throughout immeasurable and inconceivable eons, even during dark kalpas.
May I always and eternally roam the pure lands of the Buddhas.
[Name], whatever sins you have committed, may they be heard throughout the realms of the ten directions.
May all evil karma of your own body and speech be perpetually purified in every place, and may the evil karma of your mind also be purified.

One shall no longer create boundless evil karma. This is the prayer for generating the bodhicitta made by the noble Mañjuśrī in the past when he was King Eṣaḍha, in the presence of the Buddha Ghoṣadatta.
